To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we are able to measure the inverse proximity effects in the superconducting state of the superconductor/ ferromagnet interface using polarized neutrons and waveguide enhancement of standing neutron waves.
we have developed a new approach to study the proximity effects in superconducting-ferromagnetic systems.

(1) we have prepared and characterized sets of S/F samples with various parameters of S and FM layers; (2) we have made neutron standing wave measurements on S/F sample with S=Mo and FM = Co; (3) we have made calculations of neutron waveguide enhancement and compared them with experimental data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of the proximity effect at the interface between superconductors and ferromagnets.
the investigation of the influence of the proximity effect in superconductor-ferromagnet (SC/FM) layered systems.
the study of the influence of proximity effect on magnetic and superconducting properties in S/FM structures.

the neutron standing wave technique is a very promising and useful tool for studying proximity effects in superconducting/ferromagnetic systems.
the proposed technique has a great potential for the study of S/FM interfaces.
the waveguide enhancement of standing wave neutron reflectivity has been achieved and that this technique is now ready for use on S/FM systems.

we have developed the technique to measure proximity effects in S/FM interface and we have prepared the samples for this study.
we have prepared samples with high quality, we can measure neutron standing wave with waveguides, and now we are able to measure proximity effect in superconducting ferromagnets.

we have developed the technique of neutron standing waves enhancement using neutron waveguide.
